requirements: Rehash final source/authority/static manifest/protocol and accepted finite inputs; verify reviewed compiled source/header/EXE lineage.
Exact archived protocol bytes and finite output-file universe; classify any empty directories separately.
Early receipt/post-lease cleanup/final seal complete hashes and journal hash chain; missing seal or any authoritative failure/late/afterseal marker vetoes a positive result.
Exactly one reserved CreateProcess and at most one Resume; exact EXE, command, environment, detached/suspended/JOB_LIST and three-stdio HANDLE_LIST.
Owned PID/image/creation/strict-parent records and raw prelaunch/assigned/running/final Job query responses; strict generic total1, active0-or1 consistency and only own PID, final Active0/list0.
Memory limits/peaks and snapshot query caps; bounded complete child lifetime/exit/reaping with terminal observations before original handle cleanup.
Capture retained/observed/truncation fields against exact stdout/stderr bytes; physical pipe EOF is separate from observed process exit.
All original/recheck lease ownership and per-close outcomes, primary-plus-late failures, postcleanup seal; unknown creation/return/missing response remains unknown.
checks.stage: One owned process and terminal observations

requirements: Own artifact entries pass no-reparse/regular-file guards and aggregate2MiB/attempt4KiB/row64KiB/reserve64KiB caps before content reads.
Exact attempt and metadata-only stdout; strict duplicate-free/nonfinite-free bounded newline JSONL.

Use pinned f5b8 pure-parser AST or exact bound equivalent without importing launcher/SDK; independently reconstruct numeric UTF16 units, length, termination, truncation, UTF8 conversion flags and complete raw-line byte framing.

Require query reservation/return ordering/counts, one Snapshot/First, at most64 complete rows, natural Next false/error18, one snapshot Close and complete retained SystemDirectory; incomplete/error/65th/clipped metadata cannot be complete.

Raw module metadata must precede classification; recompute every ASCII-case/slash-only predicate/category and exact known EXE/core4 presence from retained units, with unresolved partial metadata never eligible.
Recompute enumeration/footer counts, attempt-plus-prefix byte counters, declaration bounds and explicit Api=false/targetCqueries0/ABIeligibilityfalse.
checks.stage: Finite child format and raw reconstruction

requirements: Reported image strings stay data: no stat/open/hash/resolve/exists calls on them and no global process scan.
Group only retained current-process snapshot metadata; classification is not permission.
Separate raw API observations, child self-reports and source-derived zero-explicit-target-call invariants.
Do not infer unknown image identity/trust, complete permanent/system inventory, actual loader cause, historical identity, old-run identity or ABI eligibility.

exit_rule: One finite actual-result assessment and a separately explicit minimum policy decision; no retry-until-pass or further OS diagnostic expansion.
prerequisites: Final exact bound parent/source/authority/static manifest/protocol peer review.
Separate root once-only census dispatch decision.
